text: hey so can you make it so that extrude edges/face lets me pick the extrude distance/angle rather than just authoring in a huge strip, it makes it a pain in the ass when your zoomed in
resolution: Replaced the model-radius one-click extrusion stamp with a blocking exact-value panel on cart/editor. Edge extrusion now accepts model-space distance plus departure angle, face and multi-face extrusion accept distance plus taper, invalid values fail before topology, and Apply remains one native journal step. Added focused TS/Zig coverage and completed a ReleaseFast editor build; user visual and 60-second spikewatch confirmation remain the review gate.
